description: How a YC-style SAFE (post-money or pre-money) converts in a priced equity round: conversion price, whether the cap or discount applies, shares issued and ownership after the round, including an option pool top-up. Use convertible_note for notes that accrue interest. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/safe-conversion-calculator

discount_pct.description: Discount to the round price in percent (20 = 20%). 0 means no discount.

existing_pool_shares.description: Unissued option pool shares today (part of existing_shares).

existing_shares.description: Fully diluted shares before the priced round, including the unissued option pool.

priced_round_pre_money_usd.description: Pre-money valuation of the priced round.

priced_round_raise_usd.description: New money raised in the priced round, not counting the SAFE.

safe_type.description: SAFE type: "post" for post-money SAFEs (the YC standard since 2018), "pre" for older pre-money SAFEs.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued option pool after the round, as a percent of post-money fully diluted shares. 0 for no top-up.

name: safe_conversion
title: SAFE conversion calculator
